Three.js 0.165.0
================

These files are copied without modifications from the official npm package:
https://registry.npmjs.org/three/-/three-0.165.0.tgz

Included: minified ES module, OrbitControls, RoomEnvironment, RoundedBoxGeometry.
The models share these same-origin files to avoid a CDN dependency and reuse the browser cache.
